stem: In the management of childhood bronchiolitis, which of the following is considered the standard of care?

options.text: Systemic corticosteroids to reduce airway inflammation
Supportive care focusing on hydration and oxygenation
Empirical antibiotic therapy to prevent secondary pneumonia

explanation: Since the cause is typically viral and the illness is self-limiting, management focuses on maintaining stability while the virus clears.
rationale: Think about whether pharmaceutical interventions or basic physiological assistance is more effective for this viral condition.

optionExplanations.A: Bronchodilators have shown no demonstrable effect on the course or outcome of viral bronchiolitis.
optionExplanations.B: Studies have indicated that steroids do not significantly benefit children suffering from bronchiolitis.
optionExplanations.C: Since the cause is typically viral and the illness is self-limiting, management focuses on maintaining stability while the virus clears.
optionExplanations.D: Antibiotics are ineffective against the viral causes of bronchiolitis and are not recommended for routine management.

originalCorrectOptionTexts: Supportive care focusing on hydration and oxygenation
